title: With a hard pair, Heisenberg counting is #P-hard with H1 = Z/r
claim: Let p be an odd prime, r | p - 1, a, b r-th roots of unity in F_p, and G = H(F_p) x| C_r with the generator acting by (x, y, z) -> (a x, b y, a b z). If a, b and ab are all nontrivial, counting homomorphisms from pi1(S^3_r(K)) to G, for knots given by diagrams, is #P-hard under polynomial-time Turing reductions, and so is counting homomorphisms from knot groups. With COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001C this gives a dichotomy for these groups on 3-manifolds with bounded first homology. The four coincidence patterns of (a, b, (ab)^-1) have Potts gadgets: p^{2m-n} Z(p^3, p^2 - 1) (patterns 1 and 3, the alternating 3-form), p^m Z(p^2, p - 1) (pattern 2) and p^{m-n} Z(p^2, p - 1) (pattern 4), all on Tutte hyperbolas (x-1)(y-1) = p^3 or p^2, #P-hard by Jaeger-Vertigan-Welsh. Base manifolds are connected sums of twist knots with m = zeta (zeta - 1)^-2 mod p; the gadget is realized by an explicit construction of disjoint Y-graphs with pure leaves, giving r-surgeries on knots K_Gamma of polynomial size. Consequently Rowell's Conjecture 3.2(b) (exact polynomial counting on link groups for solvable G) fails for these groups unless every #P function is polynomial-time computable.
failure_conditions: A gadget whose brute-force kernel count differs from its Potts value, or a Potts value that differs from the Tutte expression, or a Tutte point on the hyperbola (x-1)(y-1) = 1.
A twist knot whose twisted cohomology is not exactly at the roots of m t^2 - (2m+1) t + m in dimension one.
An end-to-end knot whose count differs from its gadget value or whose kernels differ from the prediction.
A knot group on which the counting formula disagrees with brute force, or a knot where the UT3(F4) x| C3 knot-group count is not the surgery count plus 63.
foundation_claim_scope: Odd prime fields, r-surgeries on knots and knot groups, Turing reductions. Cited, not proved: Jaeger-Vertigan-Welsh (1990), Massuyeau's Lemma 3.2 (through COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001B), Habiro's clasper calculus (Props. 3.3-3.4, disk-leaves), the Alexander polynomials of twist knots. Not run end to end: pattern 1 and the explicit pure-leaf recipe (the computed instances use bundle leaves found by search). Not covered: extension fields other than F4 with r = 3, q = 2^k in patterns 2 and 4, general class-2 groups, approximate counting. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: the four gadget lemmas by brute force over F3 and F5 (30 cases) with Potts and Tutte values, twist-knot roots for four primes, three end-to-end knots (patterns 2, 3, 4) with exact counts and kernels, knot-group counts against brute force and the +63 identity for UT3(F4) x| C3; construction repaired after the independent review COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001A; no human or external review
